name: Wine-Dark Sea, de Maria Trabulo
description: This exhibition features sculpture, photography, and painting by Maria Trabulo, exploring the concept of the sea's color through collected saltwater and personal accounts. The works reflect on the sea as a space that resists fixed boundaries, incorporating narratives of migration, economic crisis, and environmental activism.
longDescription:
The exhibition "Wine-Dark Sea" by Maria Trabulo is on display at Galeria Presença. It includes sculpture, photography, and painting, with pieces created between 2014 and 2021.

The artist collected saltwater from the Mediterranean and Atlantic, using it to reveal the ocean's chromatic presence. The works are based on descriptions of the sea's color from migrants, fishermen, and climate activists in Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

The exhibition runs from September 19 to November 7, 2026. The inauguration is on September 19 at 4:00 PM. Visiting hours are Tuesday to Saturday, from 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM. Admission is free.

longDescriptionPt:
A exposição "Wine-Dark Sea", de Maria Trabulo, está patente na Galeria Presença. Inclui escultura, fotografia e pintura, com peças criadas entre 2014 e 2021.

A artista recolheu água salgada do Mediterrâneo e do Atlântico, usando-a para revelar a presença cromática do oceano. As obras baseiam-se em descrições da cor do mar, dadas por migrantes, pescadores e ativistas climáticos em Itália, Grécia e Portugal.

A exposição decorre de 19 de setembro a 7 de novembro de 2026. A inauguração é a 19 de setembro, às 16h00. O horário de visita é de terça-feira a sábado, das 15h00 às 19h00. A entrada é gratuita.
